ax4.set_title('Purchase Channel Distribution', fontweight='bold')

ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()

ax5.set_title('Customers by Marital Status', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')

ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
colors_response = ['#e74c3c' if r == 0 else '#2ecc71' for r in df['Response']]

ax6.set_title('Age vs Recency (by Response)', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Age')
ax6.set_ylabel('Recency (days)')
# Legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#2ecc71', label='Responded'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#e74c3c', label='Not Responded')]
ax6.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
